name: Tivoli la Caleta Tenerife Resort
positioning: Oceanfront resort in Costa Adeje, Tenerife, with three outdoor pools in tropical gardens and the island's first Anantara Spa
best_for: Travelers who want an oceanfront base in Costa Adeje
Families looking for a resort with a wide range of services
Guests who want spa time, pools and padel in one place

facts.text: The hotel is in Costa Adeje, Tenerife.
The hotel is distinctive in its architecture and design and overlooks the ocean.
El Duque Beach is 0.5 kilometres from the hotel.
Rooms have a modern, contemporary design with sleek, minimalistic decor.
Rooms have private balconies or terraces.
The hotel has a World Padel Tour court.
The hotel's dining features the cooking of celebrity chef Olivier da Costa.
Teide National Park is about 40 minutes from the hotel.
Tenerife South Airport is a 20-minute taxi journey away.

highlights.text: The hotel sits right on the oceanfront.
The hotel has the first Anantara Spa in Tenerife, combining the healing traditions of east and west.
The resort has three outdoor pools set in tropical gardens.
The La Caleta suite is the hotel's most special suite, with a panoramic sea view.
Nearby adventures include surfing, diving, sailing to look for whales and dolphins, and golf at the local course.

considerations.text: The free on-site parking is outdoors; garage parking costs extra.
The hotel is on the oceanfront rather than on a beach; El Duque Beach is 0.5 kilometres away.
WhataHotel notes that sightseeing beyond the resort requires transportation.
